deductions.detail: Story 2 asserts Ansel Keddie went up in 1895 and 'tested through its first summer'; Quantities line repeats '1895 (arrival)'. Station opened 4 May 1896 and did not test before it opened.
B4 headline verdict: 'None, according to the most authoritative source' / 'Resolved: no relationship.'
D3 headline verdict: 'Yes, as to the result - but apparently not as to the cause.' No declared inability to settle the understatement question.
D1 asserts the 1911 measure was 'borrowed from Larrow Green' as fact (r04's pole).
F answers 'No evidence that it did' and asserts the crate 'had been sitting in the loft since 1923, unremarked, and was not rediscovered until 1958'; no explicit decline.
E item 10 resolves Orra/Emmet to 'full siblings'; Story 3 asserts full sibling as fact. B2 defers rather than declining.
D2 headline verdict: 'No - the sources show no such reconciliation.'
